page.layout: One column of boxed name lists, each box beside its year at left (1300 to 1307), with a marginal note at right beside the 1303 box. Below the column: the signature "T 3" at left and the catchword "Ioan-" at right. Running head and page number at the top.

main_text.l: 1303 | Joannes Fil. Minsonis.VERONA Frisiorum excisa ab Hollandiæ Comite.

page.notes: The mark before "Alardus" in the boxes for 1302, 1306 and 1306 is a printed sign, not a letter, and is left out. Spelling of the names is as printed; the 1302 and 1306 entries show accents and a dotted letter that may be printing or scan artefacts. The marginal note lies beside the 1303 box and runs over two lines. The catchword is "Ioan-" with a printed hyphen, and the text ends with the last full line.
